paragraphs: Attrition is measured on a cumulative basis across the entire room block for the event. Group has committed to ninety (90) guest rooms for the four-night stay, June 2-5, 2027. Should Group fail to occupy at least seventy-five percent (75%) of committed rooms, Group shall pay the Hotel liquidated damages equal to the room rate applicable to the unoccupied rooms, multiplied by seventy percent (70%), for each night the threshold is not met.

For any night during the event when the Hotel reaches ninety-five percent (95%) occupancy or higher, Group receives full credit toward its block commitment for that night as if all committed rooms had been occupied. Group may request the Hotel's occupancy records to verify how attrition damages were calculated, and the Hotel shall provide such records within ten (10) business days of request. Any dispute regarding attrition calculations must be raised within thirty (30) days of the Hotel's final invoice.

paragraphs: All reservations for rooms within the group block must be made on or before thirty-five (35) days prior to arrival. This cutoff date is firm and applies to all reservations made through the Hotel's group reservation desk or online portal.

Reservations requested after the cutoff date remain eligible for the negotiated group rate based on availability at the time of request, provided that the Hotel is under no obligation to hold inventory after the cutoff has passed. Any rooms released by Group or not reserved by the cutoff may be sold at the Hotel's sole discretion at any rate.

paragraphs: Group attendees may change the name on any reservation at the group rate at any time prior to arrival without additional charge or fee. An attendee who does not occupy a room on the first night of the reservation but arrives on a subsequent night shall have the remainder of the reservation honored at the same group rate and terms.

Group attendees may cancel individual room reservations without penalty or charge until 6:00 p.m. on June 2, 2027, the day of arrival. Any cancellation request received after that time and date will be subject to the Hotel's standard cancellation policy and applicable room charges. The Group contact shall notify the Hotel of all cancellations, and the Hotel will confirm cancellation in writing to the Group within one (1) business day of receipt.

paragraphs: If Group cancels this Agreement, Group shall pay to Hotel cancellation damages calculated as a percentage of lost room profit based on the date notice of cancellation is received prior to the Event dates of June 2-5, 2027. Damages are assessed on a sliding scale: if notice is given twelve (12) months or more before June 2, 2027, damages equal zero percent of lost room profit; if notice is given between nine (9) and twelve (12) months before June 2, 2027, damages equal twenty-five (25) percent of lost room profit; if notice is given between six (6) and nine (9) months before June 2, 2027, damages equal fifty (50) percent of lost room profit; if notice is given between three (3) and six (6) months before June 2, 2027, damages equal seventy-five (75) percent of lost room profit; if notice is given fewer than three (3) months before June 2, 2027, damages equal one hundred (100) percent of lost room profit.

Room profit is calculated as seventy (70) percent of the single net group rate applied to the room block less allowable attrition. Any revenue Hotel earns reselling cancelled rooms is credited against Group's damage obligation. If Group books another event at Bayfront Harbor Hotel within twelve (12) months of the cancellation, the revenue generated by that rebooked event is credited against any cancellation damages Group owes from this cancellation. No liability shall accrue during the period of twelve (12) months prior to the Event dates for any failure by Group to meet the room block.

paragraphs: Upon release of any room inventory or function space by Group, Hotel shall undertake active and commercially reasonable efforts to resell the released space at the highest rates obtainable in the market. Any net proceeds derived from Hotel's resale of released inventory shall be credited dollar-for-dollar against Group's obligation to pay cancellation damages or any other sums due under this Agreement. Hotel shall maintain records of all resale activity undertaken in connection with released inventory and shall make those records available to Group upon written request within ten (10) business days of such request.

Cancellation damages shall become due and payable only after the Event dates of June 2-5, 2027 have passed, and then only upon Hotel's delivery to Group of documentation showing the resale efforts Hotel undertook and establishing the number of rooms and function space that remained unsold after Hotel's resale attempts. Group shall have ten (10) business days from receipt of such documentation to request clarification or contest Hotel's calculations. Payment shall be due within thirty (30) days of the final determination of damages.

paragraphs: If the Hotel cancels this Agreement in violation of its material obligations and without legal right to do so, the Hotel shall indemnify and hold harmless the Group from all direct, indirect, and consequential damages arising from such wrongful cancellation, including but not limited to reasonable costs incurred in relocating the event to an alternative venue. The Hotel's obligation to indemnify the Group for wrongful cancellation shall include all reasonable attorney's fees, court costs, and legal expenses incurred by the Group in enforcing its rights under this Agreement or mitigating damages. paragraphs: Neither party shall be liable to the other for any failure to perform its obligations under this Agreement when performance becomes illegal, impossible or commercially impracticable due to an event or circumstance beyond that party's reasonable control. Force majeure events include, without limitation, government-imposed travel restrictions and official travel advisories that restrict or discourage travel to Portland, Oregon, epidemics and pandemics affecting public health or travel, and conditions of public safety, health, or infrastructure that render it unsafe or imprudent for Group's attendees to travel to or gather at the Hotel or in Portland.

If this Agreement is cancelled or terminated due to a force majeure event, Group's deposits shall be refunded to Group in full within thirty (30) days of the cancellation or termination. Cancellation for force majeure requires written notice to Hotel stating the specific force majeure event and the basis for Group's belief that the threshold of cancellations has been or will be met.

paragraphs: The Group shall incur a food and beverage minimum of Forty Thousand Dollars ($40,000.00) for the event held June 2-5, 2027. All food and beverage charges, including meals, beverages, room service, and catering, shall count toward this minimum. Pricing shall be determined by menus and rates in effect on the date the Group signs this agreement and shall remain locked for twelve (12) months from that date.

If the Group's actual food and beverage charges fall short of the minimum, the Group shall pay the Hotel the shortfall amount within thirty (30) days of the Hotel's invoice. The Hotel shall calculate the shortfall based on its standard accounting records. Any dispute regarding the calculation must be raised in writing within fourteen (14) days of the invoice; absent a timely dispute, the calculation is deemed accepted. The shortfall rate shall apply to any shortfall amount, assessed at thirty-five percent (35%) in addition to the base shortfall.

paragraphs: Gratuity and service charge are distinct charges, each with a separate definition and purpose. Gratuity is a distribution to hotel staff in recognition of service rendered, while service charge is a hotel revenue line item. Group's final bill shall separately itemize gratuity and service charge so that each charge is clearly stated with its respective amount and purpose.

Gratuity paid by Group shall be distributed in full to the service staff who worked the event. The Hotel shall provide written confirmation of gratuity distribution upon request. Service charge is the Hotel's own revenue and shall not be considered or characterized as a gratuity or tip to staff. Group shall pay a service charge of twenty-two percent (22%) calculated on the subtotal of food and beverage charges before tax.

paragraphs: For all food and beverage functions held during the Group event, the Hotel shall maintain minimum staffing ratios as follows: one (1) server for every twenty (20) guests and one (1) bartender for every seventy-five (75) guests. These staffing minimums are incorporated into the Hotel's quoted pricing and represent a material obligation of the Hotel with respect to the quality and timing of service. Any function falling below the minimum attendee threshold shall be subject to adjusted staffing and applicable fees as provided in this Agreement.

No labor fees, service fees, or bartender charges shall be assessed to the Group for any food and beverage functions with twenty-five (25) or more attendees. Functions with fewer than twenty-five (25) attendees may incur labor, bartender, or service fees at rates established by the Hotel and communicated to the Group in writing prior to the Group's acceptance of this Agreement. All fees shall be detailed on the final billing statement provided to the Group within ten (10) days following the conclusion of the event.

paragraphs: The Hotel shall not offer any member of the general public a rate lower than the rate offered to Group during the Event dates of June 2-5, 2027. The Hotel shall provide notice of any such reduction not later than sixty (60) days before the event, except in cases of emergency or force majeure, in which case notice shall be provided as soon as practicable. paragraphs: Hotel shall provide written notice to Group within thirty (30) days of any change in brand affiliation, hotel management company, or material change in ownership or control of the Hotel property. For purposes of this clause, a material change in ownership includes any sale, acquisition, merger, or transfer of majority equity interest in the Hotel or its parent company. Hotel shall include in such notice a description of the changes and the anticipated impact, if any, on Hotel operations, amenities, or service levels during Group's event dates.

Upon receipt of notice of any change in brand, management, or ownership, Group shall have thirty (30) days within which to elect to terminate this agreement without cancellation penalty. This termination right shall apply equally to any event involving bankruptcy proceedings, foreclosure action, or receivership affecting the Hotel, which shall be treated as a change of ownership for all purposes of this clause. If Group does not exercise its termination right within the thirty (30) day window, Group shall be deemed to have accepted the change and shall proceed with its event under the terms of this agreement.

paragraphs: Hotel shall notify Group in writing within twelve (12) months prior to the expiration of any collective bargaining agreement covering Hotel employees who provide service to Group, including housekeeping, food and beverage, security, and front office personnel. Such notice shall identify the union or employee organization, the coverage areas, and the current expiration date of the agreement. Hotel shall update Group every thirty (30) days thereafter regarding the status of contract negotiations, and shall immediately notify Group if a work stoppage, strike, job action, or other labor dispute becomes reasonably foreseeable.

Should any strike, work stoppage, job action, picket line, or other labor dispute occur at the Hotel during the Event dates or during the thirty (30) days preceding the event, Group may cancel this agreement by providing written notice to Hotel within ninety (90) days of the occurrence of such labor dispute. Group may cancel with no liability, penalty, or obligation to pay any fees or charges associated with this agreement if a labor dispute materially interferes with Group's ability to conduct its event or enjoy the services, amenities, and accommodations reserved. Any such cancellation shall entitle Group to the return of all deposits and advance payments within fifteen (15) business days.

paragraphs: Each party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party from and against all claims, damages, liabilities, and expenses arising out of or resulting from that party's own negligence or willful misconduct in connection with this Agreement and the Event. The indemnification obligations shall be mutual and equal in scope, with each party responsible for defending itself and the other party against claims arising from its own acts or omissions. The indemnifying party shall promptly notify the indemnified party of any claim and shall have the right to control the defense of such claim, provided that no settlement shall be made without the indemnified party's prior written consent.

Group shall maintain a policy of general liability insurance covering bodily injury, property damage, and personal injury with minimum limits of $1,000,000.00 per occurrence and $2,000,000.00 in the aggregate, naming the Hotel as an additional insured. The Hotel shall maintain adequate insurance coverage to protect its own operations and activities during the Event. paragraphs: The Hotel warrants that its guest rooms, public areas and function space comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act and all applicable state and local accessibility laws. The Hotel shall make reasonable accommodations upon request to ensure that attendees with disabilities may participate fully in the event, and the Hotel shall bear the cost of structural modifications and standard facility accommodations that the Hotel is ordinarily responsible for providing.

The cost of any auxiliary aids or services requested by Group or its attendees, including but not limited to interpreters, transcription services, specialized audio equipment and accessible transportation, shall be divided between Group and the Hotel. Group shall notify the Hotel of any such requirements at least fourteen (14) days prior to the event, and the parties shall promptly agree on the allocation and procurement of auxiliary aids.

paragraphs: The Hotel covenants that it shall not, and shall ensure that its staff do not, refuse service to, or otherwise discriminate against, any attendee of the event on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other legally protected status, regardless of whether such discrimination would be permissible under the laws of the State of Oregon or the City of Portland.

paragraphs: Group shall provide the Hotel with an attendee list for purposes of room assignment, event operations and billing only. The Hotel will not use attendee data for its own marketing purposes, and shall not employ such data in connection with promotional solicitations, advertising campaigns or any direct marketing initiative directed toward the attendees.

The Hotel will not sell or share attendee data with third parties, and shall ensure that all attendee information is handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws. Upon conclusion of the event, Group may request that the Hotel destroy or return all attendee data in the Hotel's possession, and the Hotel shall comply with such request within thirty (30) days.

paragraphs: The Hotel shall provide the Group with a written pickup report on a weekly basis during the period preceding the cutoff date. This report will show the number of rooms reserved under the block and such other information as the Hotel customarily reports to groups at this stage. The Group may request clarification of any figures in the report, and the Hotel will respond within two (2) business days.

Within thirty (30) days after the conclusion of the Event, the Hotel shall deliver to the Group a final reconciliation report setting forth all room nights sold, rates applied, and revenue generated. The Group shall have the right to audit the room block at its own expense or, if it elects to conduct the audit itself, at no cost to the Group. The Group may challenge figures in the final report within ten (10) days of receipt; after that period, the report shall be deemed accepted. The parties acknowledge that the room block shall be subject to written review at the following dates: July 1, 2026, October 1, 2026, and February 1, 2027, and at each such review date the Group may increase or decrease the block by no more than fifteen percent (15%) of the then-current commitment.

paragraphs: Group may assign this agreement to a successor or affiliated management entity provided that the assignee is in the same industry as Group, is capable of performing all obligations under the agreement, and assumes all of Group's liabilities and duties in writing. The assignee shall remain liable jointly and severally with Group for all payments and performance obligations, and Group shall remain liable to the Hotel for any default by the assignee.

The Hotel's consent to an assignment will not be unreasonably withheld, and the Hotel shall respond to any assignment request within ten (10) business days of receiving written notice from Group. Any assignment made without the Hotel's consent shall be void, and the Hotel may treat such assignment as a material breach of this agreement.
